title: Orders of retention.
bodyText: No property shall be sold or delivered under sections 52D-10 to 52D-14 if the chief of police, any county attorney or corporation counsel, or any court directs that it be retained as evidence.
bodyHtml: [§52D-13]  Orders of retention.  No property shall be sold or delivered under sections 52D-10 to 52D-14 if the chief of police, any county attorney or corporation counsel, or any court directs that it be retained as evidence. [L 1989, c 136, pt of §2]
